- `HmacAuthenticationManager.java` — Validates timestamp window, nonce length, body digest (SHA-256), nonce (Redis), then computes HMAC-SHA256 signature with `MessageDigest.isEqual` constant-time compare
- `HmacAuthenticationGatewayFilter.java` — GlobalFilter that extracts 5 HMAC headers, caches request body via `ServerHttpRequestDecorator` (prevents downstream breakage), delegates to manager, stores `GatewayPrincipal.App`
